arts.ttl: Sheffield United ease to derby victory over Sheffield Wednesday
arts.sum: Tyrese Campbell scored twice and Tom Cannon added a late third to earn Sheffield United a comfortable victory over Sheffield Wednesday in the Steel City derby.

arts.ttl: Steel City Derby LIVE: Sheffield Wednesday host Sheffield United in the Championship
arts.sum: Despite their predicament, there is a feel-good atmosphere at Hillsborough as Wednesday host United in the Steel City derby.
